title: New Aircraft & Stunning Liveries in MSFS Marketplace! ✈️✨ | Weekly Update | Week 41
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 Discover the latest additions to the Microsoft Flight Simulator (MSFS) marketplace this week! 🚀 Dive into the details of the new aircraft and explore the stunning liveries that will elevate your flying experience. This week 3 new aircrafts have landed in the marketplace. A big jet the Airbus A330 as well as 2 helicopters . Additionally for those who want to use a different livery when flying an aircraft in MSFS. Several interesting bundles  for the A320-V2 and other aircrafts such as the Boeing, CJ4 and TBM-930 are now available with an interesting discount. Whether you’re a seasoned pilot or a virtual aviation enthusiast, this update is a must-see! Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more MSFS content. 🌍🛫

📹 Other marketplace additions
If you are looking for either the new training missions or new enhanced scenery and enhanced airports review the respective video by clicking on one if the links below:
